endpoint_warning: Enrichment is not affinity, functional inhibition or antiviral activity. Do not pool metrics across landscapes with different endpoints or geometries.
interpretation: A monomer-wise split measures whether a surrogate can rank a library member built from a building block it has never seen measured. The tied-prediction rate is structural for a one-hot encoding, not an empirical finding. No binding, affinity, inhibition or antiviral property is predicted for any member.
limitations: Descriptors are per-monomer. They describe the building blocks and capture nothing about the assembled macrocycle, its conformation or the ring.
The held-out monomers are drawn from one library against one target, so the comparison is within this landscape and is not a benchmark-breadth claim.
Members are not independent replicates; they are draws from one combinatorial library measured in one campaign.
